description: Hearing-room lines the owner graded good that no scene reads yet: a witness's yes, and thanks to a chair by title. Restored Nov 8, 2026 from the hearing bank deleted in 881e7c4f. Registered stopgap SG-WORDS-hearing-no-reader. Nov 11, 2026: chair questions, witness replies, a public-comment call and a recorded-vote announcement, each modeled on a sentence from a public House hearing transcript (source.pattern), for the committee-day reader of words-hearing-chair-question.

slots.witness: The witness's name as the chair addresses them (title and surname), from the hearing's witness record.
slots.member: A committee member's name as the chair addresses them (title and surname), from the committee's seat record.
slots.section: What one of the bill's sections does, in a few words ("the minimum wage raise"), from the bill's section record.
slots.bill: The bill's short title, from the bill record.
slots.speaker: A public-comment speaker's name (title and surname), from the meeting's public-comment statement.
slots.yes: The count of members voting yes, from the hearing's recorded vote.
slots.no: The count of members voting no, from the hearing's recorded vote.
